title: trailboss --json seen
description: `trailboss seen AGENT:ID|TERMINAL` marks a session seen now: its finished turns stop counting as unread in `live`. With --unread, its latest finished turn counts as unread again, until you mark it seen or prompt it. One row.

seen_ms.description: When it was marked, in ms since the epoch.

unread.description: Whether it has an unread turn now: false after `seen`, true after `seen --unread`.
